draft_en.subject: The switch for the new buildings on Paekaare and Punane
draft_en.body:
Hi Vadim,

For the new buildings you are connecting on Paekaare and Punane: the riser switch is 24 x Gigabit RJ45 + 4 x 10G SFP+ uplinks, L2+ managed (VLAN, IGMP, QoS), Marvell-based, CE/RoHS - model STC-424XGGM - $132.7 USD EXW per unit (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); for small buildings, 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP L2+ - STC-28DGGM - $71.0. SFP+ optics you keep sourcing as now.

One question: how many risers are planned for the next phase?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
